description: We are The Selection Lab, participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge (Austin, TX) to tackle the Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge.
summary: The Moon Detective is a five-screen interactive investigation that turns children into science detectives on the Moon. Starting from a real mystery — what did Apollo 11's Passive Seismic Experiment, the first seismometer ever placed on the Moon, actually measure? — young detectives examine the instrument, study its signals, and put the evidence on trial. On the Evidence Scales screen, players sort each claim into Measured evidence, Scientific conclusion, or Scientific model, and park the rest in 'What we still don't know.' The experience follows an 'Evidence Before Narrative' approach: no claim appears without a checked NASA source behind it, and every source is listed on the project's sources page. Built by The Selection Lab for the 'Abandoned but not Forgotten' challenge, it shows how hardware left behind on the Moon still teaches us to ask what the evidence can — and cannot — support.
details: The Moon Detective is a five-screen interactive investigation for children, built for the 'Abandoned but not Forgotten' challenge. It starts from a real mystery: what did Apollo 11's Passive Seismic Experiment, the first seismometer ever placed on the Moon, actually measure? Young detectives examine the instrument, study its signals, and put the evidence on trial. On the Evidence Scales screen, players sort each claim into Measured evidence, Scientific conclusion, or Scientific model, and park the rest in 'What we still don't know.' The experience follows an 'Evidence Before Narrative' approach: no claim appears without a checked NASA source behind it, and every source is listed on the project's sources page and in the repository's SOURCES.md. The project was built by The Selection Lab: Seyyed Ali Ayati (owner) and Tatiana Ilina (concept, research, source checking, child-facing copy, and visual direction). Code, text, and illustrations are under the MIT licence; NASA material is credited to NASA and not relicensed. No NASA image, photograph, logo, or insignia is included. The public code repository is https://github.com/theselectionlab/human-knowledge-bridge and the live experience is https://theselectionlab.ai/human-knowledge-bridge/.
